newsitem.title: TURKEY: ISTANBUL GOLD JUMPS ON HIGHER WORLD LEVELS.
newsitem.headline: ISTANBUL GOLD JUMPS ON HIGHER WORLD LEVELS.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange volume rose to 1,829 kg on Friday from Thursday's 1,075 kg as traders bought gold in expectation of higher prices, dealers said.
Gold closed up sharply at $323.10 an ounce and 1,700,300 lira per gram, compared to $320.00 and 1,681,000 lira on Thursday, following rising levels on European markets.
The Turkish lira firmed slightly against the dollar to 163,010 versus 163,050 on Thursday.
Most of the day's trade -- 1,045 kg -- took place in the morning session, with 69.9 percent of the total conducted in lira terms.
